chunks.text: This week’s been a bit of a mess, and I’ve been thinking it’d be nice to line up a decent doctor in Shenzhen, just in case I finally get around to a checkup.
Also trying to pick up a hobby again—guitar, maybe. I saw something called “Guitar for Beginners” and it kinda sounded like my speed.
If that “Guitar for Beginners” thing is available, yeah, sounds good—go ahead and enroll Ethan Thomas.
And for the doctor appointment, if Dr. Wu Qiang has a morning slot on 2026-04-15, that works—just book it under Ma Liang.
